_meta.notes: Deduplicated URL registry compiled from canonical_facts.json, mechanisms.json, common_myths.json, and entities.json for the blood_sugar domain. Tiers: A=peer-reviewed, B=expert content, C=mainstream medical, D=Thai official.

sources.reliability_notes: Lean MEJ et al. 2018 — DiRECT Trial primary publication (46% T2D remission at 12 months on 825-853 kcal/d TDR). Landmark T2D-reversal RCT.
Thom G et al. 2024 — DiRECT 5-year follow-up (~11-13% sustained remission). Critical for tempering remission claims.
Lim EL et al. 2011 — Counterpoint Study: 600 kcal/d × 8 wks, hepatic glucose output normalized in 7 days, pancreatic fat fell from 8.0→5.9%. Origin of Twin Cycle Hypothesis.

sources.org: Metabolism: Clinical and Experimental / PubMed Central
sources.reliability_notes: Yin J et al. 2008 — Head-to-head RCT: berberine 500 mg TID vs metformin 500 mg TID in T2D — HbA1c -0.89% vs -0.81%, non-inferior at 3 months.
Lan J et al. 2015 — Meta-analysis of 27 berberine RCTs (n=2,569): FPG -0.71 mmol/L, HbA1c -0.73%, HOMA-IR reduction.
ADA Standards of Care 2024 — official diagnostic criteria (HbA1c ≥6.5%, FPG ≥126 mg/dL, 2h-OGTT ≥200 mg/dL). Regulatory anchor.
ADA Standards of Care 2025 — current clinical practice guidelines issue.
Wilding JPH et al. 2021 — STEP-1 Trial: semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly in 1,961 obese adults → -14.9% body weight at 68 weeks (vs -2.4% placebo). GLP-1 agonist landmark RCT.

Johnston CS et al. 2004 — vinegar ingestion (20 ml apple cider vinegar / 1.05 g acetic acid) before a carb meal improved insulin sensitivity 34% in IR subjects. Acute GLP-1 / gastric emptying mechanism.
Allen RW et al. 2013 — meta-analysis of 10 RCTs (n=543): cinnamon 1-6 g/d reduced FPG -24.59 mg/dL; no HbA1c effect.
Anderson RA et al. 1997 — 180 T2D patients, chromium picolinate 1000 µg/d × 4 mo: HbA1c -0.8%, fasting insulin -26%.
Ziegler D et al. 2011 — NATHAN 1 Trial: alpha-lipoic acid 600 mg/d × 4 yr in diabetic neuropathy, significant neuropathy impairment score improvement.

sources.org: European Review for Medical and Pharmacological Sciences / PubMed
sources.reliability_notes: Costantino D et al. 2009 — myo-inositol 2 g BID × 12-16 wks in 42 PCOS women: HOMA-IR -75%, 72% restored ovulation.
Vuksan V et al. 1999 — glucomannan (konjac) 0.5 g per 100 kcal × 3 wks in T2D: fructosamine -5.2%, LDL -20.7%.

sources.org: European Journal of Clinical Nutrition / PubMed
sources.reliability_notes: Veronese N et al. 2016 — meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (n=1,473): magnesium 100-500 mg/d reduced FBG -0.31 mmol/L, improved HOMA-IR in IR/hypomagnesemic subjects.
Reference linked to Bikman 'Why We Get Sick' insulin resistance framing — hyperinsulinemia precedes T2D by decades.
Peer-reviewed open reference on diabetes diagnosis and HOMA-IR metrics.
Matthews DR et al. 1985 — HOMA-IR original publication (formula: fasting insulin × fasting glucose / 405).
Hall H et al. 2018 — CGM study in 57 non-diabetic subjects: identical white-bread meals produce 30-180 mg/dL postprandial glucose range. Personalized glycemic response.
Shukla AP et al. 2015 — meal sequencing: vegetables+protein before carbs reduced postprandial glucose AUC by 73% and insulin AUC by 49%.
IDF Diabetes Atlas 2021 Thailand country profile — prevalence ~10.8% of adults.
IDF Diabetes Atlas master registry.
Fructose-specific hepatic DNL reference — up to ~30% of ingested fructose converted to lipid via liver.
Reynolds AN et al. 2016 — meta-analysis of 7 studies: 10-15 min post-meal walking reduces postprandial glucose.

sources.org: Jason Fung / The Fasting Method (IDM Program)
sources.reliability_notes: Jason Fung's official clinical platform — T2D remission via therapeutic fasting. Insulin-centric hypothesis.
Goldenberg JZ et al. 2021 — meta-analysis of 23 low-carb RCTs (n=1,357): 57% T2D remission at 6 months on LCD <130 g/d.
Saltiel AR 'Insulin Action and Type 2 Diabetes' (2023) — canonical reference for insulin signaling cascade (PI3K/Akt/GLUT4).
Roy Taylor 2021 review — Twin Cycle Hypothesis; personal fat threshold; DiRECT mechanism.
Taylor 2025 restatement of Twin Cycle — ectopic fat in liver+pancreas drives β-cell dysfunction.
Crossover review on hyperinsulinemia and leptin resistance — cited by Bikman framing.
Intermittent fasting vs caloric restriction in T2D — HbA1c outcomes.
Meta-analysis anchor for supplement effect sizes (glucose-related).
Suez J et al. 2014 — non-caloric artificial sweeteners induce glucose intolerance via gut microbiota. Counter-evidence for 'diet soda safe' myth.
Roy Taylor group official page — MR spectroscopy liver/pancreas fat measurement, T2D reversal research.
US federal authoritative diabetes patient+clinician education resource.
WHO authoritative diabetes topic page — global prevalence and classification.
WHO 2023 guideline advising against non-sugar sweeteners for weight control — used to debunk 'diet drinks = safe' myth.
